name: U16-1-stop-process-ended
steps: const r=document.querySelector('.screen');if(!r?.textContent.includes('Agent process ended on the computer'))throw Error('Missing process receipt');document.querySelector('.work-body .notice')?.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});const heading=[...document.querySelectorAll('h2,h3')].find(e=>e.textContent==='Stop receipt');heading?.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});

name: U16-2-preview-queued_for_boundary
steps: (async()=>{const {previewDrafts}=await import('/src/screens/control/previewDrafts.ts');const {previewDeliveries}=await import('/src/screens/control/previewDelivery.ts');const h=window.__sim.host;let d;for(const p of h.previews){d=(await previewDrafts.list('sim-studio',p.preview_id))[0];if(d)break;}if(!d)throw Error('Picture missing');const task=h.tasks.find(t=>t.task_id===d.taskId);task.title='wait';task.state="queued_for_boundary"==='failed'?'interrupted':'working';h.emit({type:'task_upserted',task:{...task}});previewDeliveries('sim-studio').set({[d.id]:{taskId:task.task_id,taskTitle:'wait',at:Date.now(),bundleId:'shot-bundle',revision:1,state:'host_accepted'}});h.emit({type:'timeline_appended',task_id:task.task_id,item:{seq:h.seq+1,at:Date.now(),run_id:task.current_run,item:{kind:'user_message',text:'Please review this picture',delivery:"queued_for_boundary",bundle:{bundle_id:'shot-bundle',revision:1,sources:[],marks:[],comments:[],steps:[],general_note:null,speech:null}}}});})()

const p=[...document.querySelectorAll('.preview-draft p')].find(e=>e.textContent.includes("Waiting to send to wait"));if(!p)throw Error('Wrong picture status');p.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});if(false && !p.closest('.preview-draft').textContent.includes('Send again'))throw Error('No resend action');

name: U16-4-leftover-pointer
steps: (async()=>{const s=document.querySelector('.an-canvas svg');const r=s.getBoundingClientRect();const i=s.querySelector('image');const x=r.x+Number(i.getAttribute('x'))+Number(i.getAttribute('width'))*.2;const y=r.y+Number(i.getAttribute('y'))+Number(i.getAttribute('height'))*.2;s.setPointerCapture=()=>{};for(const [type,id,primary,dx,dy] of [['pointerdown',41,false,0,0],['pointerdown',42,true,0,0],['pointermove',42,true,80,50],['pointerup',42,true,80,50]]){s.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type,{bubbles:true,pointerId:id,pointerType:'touch',isPrimary:primary,clientX:x+dx,clientY:y+dy}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,30));}if(!s.getAttribute('aria-label').includes('1 marks'))throw Error('Primary touch did not recover');})()

steps: const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('.terminal-recovery button')].find(b=>b.textContent.includes('Open a new terminal'));const r=b?.getBoundingClientRect();if(!r||r.top<0||r.bottom>innerHeight)throw Error('Recovery outside viewport');if(!b.closest('.screen__inner'))throw Error('Recovery outside column');
